title: Leo and the Cup That Slipped
subtitle: A spill is something to solve, not someone to blame
description: The water hit the floor before Leo's cardboard tower did. When a classroom spill becomes a label, Ms Chen repairs the line, keeps everyone safe and gives Leo a way back into the moment. The final page gives parents, carers and educators a key message and practical ideas for shared discussion and rehearsal.
